encrypted_airkiss_extension.policy: Explicit keyed mode, 1..16 raw key bytes zero-padded to16; padded key also IV; only password encrypted; ciphertext0 or16..80, total<=113. PKCS7 every suffix byte checked, decoded password<=64, padding-only blocks rejected; empty password requires zero ciphertext. No fallback/authentication or reliable wrong-key detection. Configuration/key copied and retained across reset; callback user pointer borrowed. Volatile clear of AirKiss context/transient plaintext and PSA temporary output; not a universal secure-erasure claim.
